name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI coding assistant inside your editor and on GitHub
description: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant with inline suggestions, chat, an agent mode and a command-line tool, sold in Free, Pro, Pro+ and Max plans plus business offerings.
features: Copilot in the cloud: assign work and create pull requests (paid plans)
Delegation to third-party agents (preview, Pro+ and Max)
strengths: Paid plans have unlimited inline suggestions
Extra usage can be bought as AI credits (1 credit = $0.01)
limitations: Free plan is limited to 2,000 inline suggestions per month and entry-level models
Business and Enterprise pricing is not shown on the page

plans.name: Pro
highlights: $15 of total AI credits per month ($10 base + $5 flex)

plans.name: Pro+
highlights: $70 of total AI credits per month

plans.name: Max
highlights: $200 of total AI credits per month

free.details: Limited chat and agent usage, 2,000 inline suggestions per month, entry-level models, agent mode and CLI.

api.summary: Extra usage beyond included credits is available through a flex allotment or by buying credits; 1 AI credit = $0.01 USD. Budget alerts trigger at 75%, 90% and 100%.

notes: Business and Enterprise pricing: contact sales (not shown on the page).

verification.notes: Product active. Individuals tab, USD: Free $0 (2,000 completions a month), Pro $10, Pro+ $39, Max $100 per user/month. Included monthly credits: Pro $15, Pro+ $70, Max $200. Business tab not re-read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: An AI coding agent built into the place your code already lives

capabilities.title: Start from an issue or pull request
capabilities.text: Open a session with the task, the discussion and the repository context already connected.

capabilities.title: Run several tasks in parallel
capabilities.text: Give each task its own session and follow all of them from one view.

capabilities.title: Review code before it ships
capabilities.text: Find code quality and security issues in local changes before you open a pull request, then choose which findings to act on.

capabilities.title: Automate recurring work
capabilities.text: Run reusable agent tasks on demand, on a schedule or from supported triggers.

featureCards.name: Copilot cloud agent
featureCards.text: Hand follow-up changes from a pull request review to the agent.

featureCards.name: Model choice
featureCards.text: Let Copilot pick a model per task, choose one yourself, bring your own API key, or run local models with Ollama and Foundry Local.

featureCards.name: Many places to work
featureCards.text: Use the Copilot desktop app, the CLI, editors such as Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, Xcode, Neovim, Eclipse and Zed, plus Slack, Teams, GitHub Mobile and the web.

featureCards.name: Extend Copilot
featureCards.text: Add repository instructions and skills, Copilot Connectors for external data and tools, and MCP servers and plugins.

featureCards.name: Continue across surfaces
featureCards.text: Check on or resume long-running tasks from the app, CLI, editor, github.com or GitHub Mobile.

audienceDetail.text: The Free, Pro, Pro+ and Max plans are for individuals.
The Business plan is for organisations that want to share Copilot across a team.
The Enterprise plan is described for scaling Copilot across a company.

scenarios.title: Morning issue triage
scenarios.text: A daily automation reviews recently opened or updated issues and suggests priority, effort and owner.

scenarios.title: Track several issues at once
scenarios.text: Run parallel sessions, one per issue, and follow them together.

scenarios.title: Catch a bug in review
scenarios.text: The page shows a review that flags a possible race condition in a session cache and suggests a thread-safe map.

gettingStarted.text: Download the desktop app, install the CLI, or open Copilot in an editor such as VS Code.
Begin from an issue, a pull request or a repository.
GitHub Docs, the Copilot App training and tutorials walk through the basics.
The page says you can begin on the Free plan with no credit card.
